_comment: Hold-formation default (#1095): the player's own Infantry regiment (team 0, top) is given NO order and left on the default NORMAL stance. It holds its formation in place instead of auto-advancing onto the detected-but-out-of-range enemy across the field -- its position field never moves through the whole approach. The AI enemy Infantry (team 1, bottom) still marches in under its own order and locks in melee, so the fight comes to the player's line. No scripted steps: the whole point is that the player unit does nothing and stays put. Infantry-vs-Infantry (no charge bonus) reaches contact cleanly, avoiding the small-cavalry first-contact wipe in #1151.
